notes.title: We're announcing first two station of our Roadmap!
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors! 

We are excited to share our plans for the evolution of Pandemic Train. Get ready for an enhanced exploration experience, a more immersive world, and addictive gameplay improvements!

1) Exploration events and side missions:


 Dynamic Events: We plan to add events to the game that occur during the exploration phase of specific areas. 
 Side missions from NPCs: We want our non-playable characters to offer one-time missions to complete 
 World-building: We will create new map locations with intriguing facts about our post-apocalyptic world.
 Improved leader missions: Leader missions will be revamped to provide a more immersive and rewarding experience.


2) Improved train experience:

[olist]
 Passenger Dynamics: Your train will be able to host additional passengers, each with unique goals like getting to a certain destination.
 Passenger interaction: You will have the choice to remain neutral or use the passengers for your benefit, adding a moral dimension to your decisions.
 Train and exploration: We'd like to make the exploration and train phases more influential on each other
[/olist]

Each of these first two stations of our roadmap will require a couple of months of development. Therefore, we're not giving you any specific dates yet, but you can be sure we're already working on the first part.

Join us in shaping the future of Pandemic Train!

notes.title: Pandemic Train - Game's Update 1.1!
notes.content:
Attention, Survivors!

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the first update for Pandemic Train, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect:

New Salesman Kulson:
Meet Kulson, a new vendor who will appear in locations different than those with the Bone Collector. Kulson offers unique goods and items to help you on your Pandemic Train adventure. Be ready for exciting new offerings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/03e07b13fc1e08591f469ecb1dc3453f3642eb52.png

Travel Innovation - "Jump" to selected locations:
Harness the power of metacurrency to leap to your chosen destination! With the latest update, Kovalsky's happy to smuggle you and your crew, enabling strategic movements from HQ across the map… if only you have some extra metacurrency to offer him in exchange. Plan your routes wisely and stay one step ahead of the pandemic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/bc0ae12e4c93e8e2436e39aa9944be2b5945177e.png

Persistent Train Modules:
Your train is now more resilient than ever! After facing the challenges of the pandemic head-on, your train's modules will remain intact upon your return to headquarters or even after unfortunate incidents resulting in the loss of a life. Keep building and fortifying your train for the ultimate pandemic survival.

Module Schematics Remain After Death:
Fear not, engineers! In the face of adversity, your hard-earned module schematics will persist even in the event of death. Your knowledge and progress are not lost, ensuring a more rewarding and strategic gameplay experience.

Get ready to dive back into the world of Pandemic Train with these awaited by you features! We appreciate your dedication to the game and hope these enhancements add a new layer of excitement to your railroading adventures.

More changes and improvements made can be found in the changelog:

Changelog
[expand type=details]

Added:

 - After death or returning to HQ, modules built on the train remain.
 - After death, schematics of modules purchased remain, including when returning to Headquarters and completing a Run.
 - We added the ability to "jump" to a location of your choice for a metavalue (after reaching a minimum of the third location).
 - We added a new salesman - Kulson on maps without Bone Collector
 - We added the possibility to skip the tutorial on the train
 - We added a button to change the camera angle on the train

Changed:
 - We improved the Balance related to the mechanics update

Fixed:
 - Fixed dialog display for 21:9 and 16:10 screens 
 - Fixed a reported bug of snipers not firing a bullet on the first shot
 

[/expand]

Stay vigilant, stay strategic, and keep the pandemic at bay!

The Pandemic Train Development Team

Creating Pandemic Train was a truly exciting process for all of us. Each day of development was full of new experiences and knowledge. Morale and unmet needs
Each member of the train's crew has a morale indicator, which means that every time one of them runs out of resources, their morale and health will drop. A crew member whose morale gets down to zero might abandon their post.

Backpack
We have introduced a mechanic into the game that allows the player to decide what utility items he wants to carry with him during exploration and combat. A first aid kit? A crowbar? notes.title: The one about your beta feedback and our solutions
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,
We're back with more information on the beta test feedback and our solutions. We can't tell you all the secrets, however, we want to spill a little bit on what we're working on.

Managing the train
In beta tests, a lot of you said that managing the train is the best part of the game. You wanted more time on the train and, what's more important, way more things to do there. So we decided to add some steam to the game (hehe, gotcha!) and change things a bit. We're still testing different options, but you can be sure that your hero's skill in different fields will affect what and how many resources of each kind can they produce. 

Have hope, or else...
Your comparisons to many great games like Fallout Shelter or This War of Mine flatter us enormously! We love these productions so much and would love to make something similar that becomes an example to follow. However, with these correlations comes your need for a morale system or moral dilemmas. Therefore, we've introduced the parameter of hope. 
How will it affect your gameplay though? Well, just you wait... Just you wait! :)  

Combat and exploration
One of your biggest concerns was combat. You didn't enjoy it, said it's too hard and challenging. There were also some issues regarding aiming. We've analyzed all comments about these aspects and improved fighting at train stations. There is also a bit more happening during exploration, especially in the 2nd biome. Many more kinds of resources lay around, just waiting for you to be taken (with or without spilling your enemy's blood). 
We're also glad to say that we're working hard on the game's balance and making the story level a bit easier. 

What's next?
All these things are still just a part of what we're doing. However, if you want, you can already express your feeling about them in the comments.
Also, we will soon e-mail those of you who sent the best feedback earlier on and ask you to play the newest build of the game. Check your mailboxes around mid-June.

Remember, there is always light at the end of every tunnel.
Pandemic Train team

notes.content:
Hello survivors! 


Today's devlog will be dedicated to the enemies we meet while exploring in the open. Let's get acquainted with them!

As for the order of exploration…
 Let's start with biome one:

Machos - Large melee gang members are powerfully built howlers with really high strength, but they are not very fast. These tough guys will require the player to fire more shots than the others.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/ab6b60c16ff3d8cc48b06b92b7bd7b4015dc5538.jpg

Chicos - with no better prospects than working for the Cerdos gang. Alarmed, they run up to the player at the distance of their ranged attack and fire shots with small arms. 

Snipers – They are usually well protected and hide behind cover during combat. They shoot very slowly, but effectively. It's best to get out of their line of fire or try your luck at dodging, otherwise, you won't live long.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/034c439a769394452fb698eb0450a33eb80ec7d2.png

Second biome:
Here we will meet a group of Cultists. 

Butcher is a fighter, who as soon as he gets close to you will bring out a series of hits worthy of admiration – if only it wasn't aimed at you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/5ed0a52541d02ebdf76fedb6f976249f08711119.jpg

Trapper is moderately suitable for fighting, but this is not the role he plays in this group. His goal is to ambush you! Hiding is what he does best, so keep your eyes open, or he will surprise you. 

Hunter, who doesn't like to get his hands dirty in hand-to-hand combat, so will shoot at you from a safe distance with a crossbow, waiting for his tainted arrows to finish you off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/898ce17a953ab1928b10dd18f364683e004112bb.png

Rats. Slimy rat-like creatures on two legs are not too dangerous, as long as you encounter a single individual. Unfortunately… devious rats attack only in a larger group, and believe me, their teeth and claws will infect you with a worse mess than tetanus. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/dad7104c32880c4b99d9d99e98e62b1454845b82.png

Third biome

The large Otterbears are relatively slow creatures that jump at their enemies, using their size and weight to fight. The white color is their camouflage, they are not very intelligent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/d24ddd98ed32f4a37260c35bae60ec2fb9442038.jpg

Volker – Wolves that rely on speed and claws. Better not let them come close. They were created by mixing beta fluid and wolf blood. 

Plague Soldat - Soldiers of The Plague were not transformed into animals. Under their masks, they hide faces deformed by their unfinished transformation. They are fighting from a distance.

notes.title: Let's talk Pandemic Train: Codex
notes.content:
Welcome survivors!

Today is one of devlog Thursdays with more news on Pandemic Train! 

We want to show you a part of the pause menu in our game. You're probably wondering what may be so interesting about a pause menu. Well, let us tell you a bit about it, then!

When you're playing a game, and you want to learn more about a particular thing or mechanic, you don't want your character to be exposed to attacks while you're trying to gain knowledge, do you?

For this purpose we created a codex which is located in the pause menu. You click ESC and all the needed information is available to you!
But what can you actually find out there? 
Here we have several tabs in the codex, so let's start one by one:

Characters
- Here you will find all the leaders you have already met during the game. You can learn all about them here. The total amount of HP, what weapons are used by a given leader, what he can do that others can't, what module you get with him at the start, and even his biography!
However, that's not all, you will also find information about the enemies you have already met! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/e686bb905bc29dcce18b76d445ece913f298de48.jpg

Items
- List of all discovered items and information about them. They are divided into 4 categories:
1. components – craft items, basic raw materials, 
2. usable – consumable items, e.g., plague vial, vaccine, water, food, 
3. weapons – here we see the strengths and weaknesses of leaders' weapons
4. special items – items to be found in the world, which can be assigned to leaders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/3554877836d961d7171e1c5a398bb8499f2f3589.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/06a251c3a4a2e8753ee98c27170ee8223e3129ef.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/0b8a850ec306b331b9e40b5523d7191554c60da2.jpg

HQ
-  Here you will be able to look into your progress at the headquarters. Information about the bonuses you already have and those you will get after upgrading HQ is located here.

Trying to survive in the world of Pandemic Train we cross the map from location to location in our old school machine. The train is the most important part of our gameplay. It's where we build, produce and heal our crew. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/f837ae2135b07b0c0d8cf4f34695261ba62b53a7.png

However, not every character will produce the same amount of items or heal the same way. Whether it's a worker or our leader... each has their own skills.
 
As we start our journey, each character has skills. They are at level zero, but we can improve them by repeating the same action with one character. With each repetition, the level of the skill will grow for that character.

Use your skills wisely! This will be especially important in the early game.

All workers receive the same starting skill set, while leaders have unique skills that are useful in battle or production.

Each leader belongs to one of the classes :

 Ethan - Medic

notes.title: Let's Talk Pandemic Train: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/dc0535495c1917e326cacf1c90e66cb37d0fd169.png

Hello community!

We were so immersed in our preparations that we almost forgot second important event this month- we are proud to announce, that we are taking part in this years edition of Steam Next Fest 2022!
From February 21st to 28th, you will be able to try out our Pandemic Train in more updated version. During this week you will also be able chat with us, watch our livestream in immerse in our build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38645368/be78687b3537ac2ea0856985e26381529a14c8bb.jpg

Okay but how will you know when or where will you find us?

It's simple. During this time games that are presented on the festival will be organized on the main page based on what category we have selected and the tags that are adornet to our game. So be cautious about them game tags!

You probably also wondering, when you will be able to watch the live stream?

Do not fret! Steam Next Fest allows us to pick up to two times for the livestream to show up. So if you will miss the first live stream of the day, because you probably had to fight with other people on some Snowpiercer or other Trans-Siberian train, you can watch the second one of the day

Souns like and exciting week huh? We hope so!
